caption: AI agents can shop now. Handing one your card is the scary part.
say: AI agents can shop now. But handing one your credit card is the scary part.

caption: Mandate gives the agent a budget. The model proposes. Plain code decides.
say: Mandate gives the agent a budget instead. The AI proposes. Plain code decides.

caption: A mandate is an envelope: limits, categories, expiry.
say: A mandate is like a sealed envelope: limits, categories, and an expiry date.

caption: Gel pens are inside the mandate: cleared.
say: The agent asks for gel pens. That is inside the mandate, so it is cleared.

caption: Cleared purchases become a PayPal Orders v2 order. (Simulated here; real sandbox with your own keys.)
say: Cleared purchases become a PayPal Orders v2 order. Here it is simulated, and with your own sandbox keys it runs on the real PayPal sandbox.

caption: Above the ask-me-first threshold: held for the owner.
say: A desk lamp is above the ask me first threshold, so it is held for the owner.

caption: Owner approves, then PayPal pays.
say: The owner approves, and PayPal pays.

caption: Wrong category and over the limit: refused, with every rule and the numbers.
say: A bottle of whisky is the wrong category, and over the limit. Refused, with every rule and the exact numbers.

caption: Plug in your own PayPal sandbox keys. They stay in this tab only.
say: Want the real thing? Plug in your own PayPal sandbox keys. They stay in your browser tab only.

caption: Every request, decision and PayPal order id lands in the ledger.
say: Every request, decision, and PayPal order lands in the ledger.

caption: Write a mandate in plain English and the form fills itself in.
say: Write a mandate in plain English, and the form fills itself in.

caption: Revoke an envelope and the agent has no spending power. Instantly.
say: Revoke an envelope, and the agent has no spending power. Instantly.

caption: The server re-prices every cart and re-checks the mandate before any PayPal order.
say: The server re-prices every cart, and re-checks the mandate, before it creates any PayPal order.

caption: Mandate: give your AI agent a budget, not your card.
say: Mandate. Give your AI agent a budget, not your card.
